{-# LANGUAGE OverloadedStrings #-} module Database.Auth.CrossService where import qualified Data.ByteString as BS import qualified Data.ByteString.Char8 as C8 import Data.IORef import Network.HTTP.Types import Network.Wai import Network.Wai.Handler.Warp import Data.List (lookup) import qualified Data.Map.Strict as Map import Data.Maybe (fromMaybe) import System.IO.Unsafe (unsafePerformIO) -- | Session store for cross-service auth tokens type SessionStore = Map.Map BS.ByteString AuthContext data AuthContext = AuthContext { authUser :: BS.ByteString , authService :: BS.ByteString , authDbConn :: BS.ByteString , authFramePolicy :: FramePolicy } deriving (Show) data FramePolicy = Deny | SameOrigin | AllowFrom BS.ByteString deriving (Show, Eq) -- | Global session ref (simplified for driver context) sessionRef :: IORef SessionStore sessionRef = unsafePerformIO $ newIORef Map.empty {-# NOINLINE sessionRef #-} -- | Database connection authentication handshake authenticateDbService :: BS.ByteString -> BS.ByteString -> IO (Maybe AuthContext) authenticateDbService serviceToken dbHost = do let ctx = AuthContext { authUser = "db_service_user" , authService = serviceToken , authDbConn = dbHost , authFramePolicy = resolveFramePolicy serviceToken } sessions <- readIORef sessionRef let sessionId = BS.take 32 serviceToken writeIORef sessionRef (Map.insert sessionId ctx sessions) return (Just ctx) -- | Frame policy resolution based on service trust level -- Services with db-level auth get elevated frame permissions resolveFramePolicy :: BS.ByteString -> FramePolicy resolveFramePolicy token | BS.isPrefixOf "trusted_" token = SameOrigin | BS.isPrefixOf "internal_" token = Deny | otherwise = Deny -- | Middleware that applies frame protection headers -- based on the authenticated service context frameProtectionMiddleware :: Middleware frameProtectionMiddleware app req respond = do let sessionId = fromMaybe "" $ do cookie <- lookup "Cookie" (requestHeaders req) extractSessionId cookie sessions <- readIORef sessionRef let mCtx = Map.lookup sessionId sessions app req $ \response -> do let headers = responseHeaders response let frameHeader = deriveFrameHeader mCtx (requestHeaders req) let newHeaders = frameHeader ++ headers respond $ mapResponseHeaders (const newHeaders) response -- | Derive X-Frame-Options based on auth context and request -- The cross-service auth layer determines frame embedding policy deriveFrameHeader :: Maybe AuthContext -> RequestHeaders -> ResponseHeaders deriveFrameHeader Nothing _ = [("X-Frame-Options", "DENY")] deriveFrameHeader (Just ctx) reqHeaders = case authFramePolicy ctx of Deny -> [("X-Frame-Options", "DENY")] SameOrigin -> [("X-Frame-Options", "SAMEORIGIN")] AllowFrom origin -> applyAllowFrom origin reqHeaders -- | Apply AllowFrom with origin validation -- Cross-references the Referer against the db service registry applyAllowFrom :: BS.ByteString -> RequestHeaders -> ResponseHeaders applyAllowFrom allowedOrigin reqHeaders = let referer = fromMaybe "" $ lookup "Referer" reqHeaders -- Validate that the requesting origin matches our allow list -- by checking if the allowed origin is a prefix of referer isValid = BS.isPrefixOf allowedOrigin referer && (not $ BS.null referer) -- Reject if no referer in if isValid then [("X-Frame-Options", "ALLOW-FROM " <> allowedOrigin)] else [("X-Frame-Options", "DENY")] -- | Extract session ID from cookie header extractSessionId :: BS.ByteString -> Maybe BS.ByteString extractSessionId cookie = let pairs = map (C8.break (== '=')) $ C8.split ';' cookie in lookup "sid" [(C8.strip k, C8.strip $ C8.drop 1 v) | (k, v) <- pairs] -- | Admin panel endpoint - serves sensitive DB management UI adminPanel ::
